::: {#def-centered-sums}
#### Centered sums of squares

For data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$,
the **centered sums of squares** of the $x_i$ and of the $y_i$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}
S_{xx} &\eqdef \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})^2, &
S_{yy} &\eqdef \sumin (y_i - \bar{y})^2.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#def-centered-cross-product}
#### Centered sum of cross-products

For the data of @def-centered-sums,
the **centered sum of cross-products** is

$$
S_{xy} \eqdef \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})(y_i - \bar{y}).
$$

:::
